if (CLINGOLPX_MATH_LIBRARY STREQUAL "imath" OR DEFINED SKBUILD)
    set(_CLINGOLPX_MATH_LIBRARY "imath")
elseif (CLINGOLPX_MATH_LIBRARY STREQUAL "auto")
    find_package(FLINT)
    if (FLINT_FOUND)
        set(_CLINGOLPX_MATH_LIBRARY "flint")
    else()
        set(_CLINGOLPX_MATH_LIBRARY "imath")
    endif()
elseif (CLINGOLPX_MATH_LIBRARY STREQUAL "flint")
    find_package(FLINT REQUIRED)
    set(_CLINGOLPX_MATH_LIBRARY "flint")
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "unknown math library")
endif()

add_library(clingo-lpx-math INTERFACE)
clingolpx_target_properties(TARGETS clingo-lpx-math TYPE extra)
if (_CLINGOLPX_MATH_LIBRARY STREQUAL "imath")
    add_library(imath STATIC)
    target_sources(imath PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/imath/imath.c
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/imath/imrat.c)
    target_include_directories(imath PUBLIC
        "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/imath>")
    if (CLINGOLPX_BUILD_SHARED)
        set_target_properties(imath PROPERTIES
            POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(clingo-lpx-math INTERFACE imath)
    target_compile_definitions(clingo-lpx-math INTERFACE CLINGOLPX_USE_IMATH)
else()
    target_link_libraries(clingo-lpx-math INTERFACE FLINT::FLINT)
    target_compile_definitions(clingo-lpx-math INTERFACE CLINGOLPX_USE_FLINT)
endif()
add_library(math::math ALIAS clingo-lpx-math)

if (CLINGOLPX_BUILD_TESTS)
    if (NOT TARGET Catch2::Catch2WithMain)
        if (CLINGOLPX_USE_LOCAL_CATCH)
            set(CATCH_BUILD_STATIC_LIBRARY ON CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE)
            add_subdirectory(catch)
        else()
            find_package(Catch2 3.1 REQUIRED)
        endif()
        include(CTest)
        include(Catch)
    endif()
    list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/pytest-cmake/cmake")
    find_package(Pytest 8.0.0)
endif()

if (NOT DEFINED SKBUILD)
    add_subdirectory(pybind11)
endif()
